decisionsTitle: «Adaugă o persoană» sets a member's level in the same step
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19 16:30**, looking at «Echipa» → «Adaugă o persoană» (address, name, «Rol», language, «Adaugă»): «Also on the members I should be able to set the tiers directly from here.»

**Decision (amends §811 and §817, which gave a level a select on each member's row and one on «Adaugă mai mulți membri»).** The level can be chosen when adding one person too: under «Rol», a select «Nivel» (the levels not hidden, in the club's order, «—» for none) shows while the role is «Membru» and writes the level with the account in the same transaction, audited as `staff.member_tier.set` with `reason: "invite"` (the row and the level by id, never a name or an address). Nothing else about the rule moves: the Administrator's alone (asserted in the service and in the action), a `MEMBER` account only, never a hidden or unknown level, each refusal naming the box «Nivel», and the invitation email is the same with or without a level — the level is the staff's label and the member is never told it. The select is one shared component, `MemberTierSelect`, drawn by the member rows, «Adaugă mai mulți membri» and «Adaugă o persoană»; the bulk form took a scope of its own so its «Nivel» and language boxes no longer share an id with the single form's.

**Refused:** a level silently dropped when the role is not «Membru» (the service refuses it, as the row's select does); a third copy of the select; a level in the invitation email (§817: no member is shown a level). **No migration.**
changelogLine: - **«Adaugă o persoană» sets a member's level** — under the role «Membru», a select «Nivel» writes the level with the account in the same step, audited, and the invitation email is unchanged; the same select as the member rows and «Adaugă mai mulți membri». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 167. A member's level can also be chosen when one person is added, in «Nivel» under the role «Membru» of «Adaugă o persoană»: the Administrator's alone, written with the account in the same transaction and audited by ids as `staff.member_tier.set`, and a level posted with any other role, a hidden level, an unknown id or by anyone but an Administrator is refused naming the box and adds nobody; the invitation email is the same with or without a level (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
